links.outcome: Model fairness (disparity ratio) across age, sex, and education subgroups
links.effect: Average disparity ratio was 0.86 for sex, 0.47 for education level, and 0.33 for age groups, showing subgroup performance gaps.
links.quote: Fairness analysis revealed that models were consistent for sex (average Disparity Ratio (DR) = 0.86), to a lesser extent for education level (average Disparity Ratio (DR) = 0.47) and worse for age groups (average Disparity Ratio (DR) = 0.33).

unlisted_practices: Uncertainty estimation with selective classification (abstention) for speech-based mental health risk models

screen.reason: Evaluates speech-based risk prediction for mental health symptoms, explicitly evaluating fairness across demographic groups and uncertainty estimation with selective classification (abstention rates for uncertain cases).

primary.practice: uncertainty estimation with selective prediction / abstention
